caption:
Netflix just hired the former marketing head of Apple Podcasts to lead its audio expansion. Meanwhile, they also cut a thousand jobs. So we are losing staff but getting more talk shows on our screens. What podcast do you actually listen to all the way through?

@netflix_in @apple

Source: Variety

#Netflix #Podcasts #ContentStrategy #StreamingNews #CreatorEconomy

post.news: Netflix hired former Apple podcast marketing head Steve Wilson to lead its podcast content acquisitions.
post.take: First they lay off a thousand people, now they want us to listen to more podcasts.
post.insight: Streaming platforms are doubling down on audio as a cheaper way to keep users hooked between TV seasons.
